```
def _paginate_detail(query, page: int, page_size: int):
    total = query.with_entities(func.count(EmployeeWorkHour.id)).scalar() or 0
    sums = query.with_entities(
        func.coalesce(func.sum(EmployeeWorkHour.work_hours), 0),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(EmployeeWorkHour.overtime_hours), 0),
    ).one()
    rows = (
        query.order_by(
            EmployeeWorkHour.work_date.desc(),
            EmployeeWorkHour.employee_no,
            EmployeeWorkHour.id.desc(),
        )
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
        .all()
    )
    items = [_row_to_detail_item(r) for r in rows]
    return items, total, round(float(sums[0]), 2), round(float(sums[1]), 2)
```
